sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Teams WHERE year = 2006 AND W > L AND Pts > 100
SELECT name FROM Teams WHERE year = 1995 AND name IN ('Florida Panthers', 'Edmonton Oilers', 'Los Angeles Kings') ORDER BY CAST(PKC AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.W FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN TeamVsTeam AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.name = 'Philadelphia Flyers' AND T2.oppID = 'BOS' AND T2.year = 1985

SELECT T3.name FROM TeamVsTeam AS T1 INNER JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.oppID = T2.tmID INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T1.year = T3.year AND T1.tmID = T3.tmID WHERE T2.name = 'Buffalo Sabres' AND T1.year = 2000 GROUP BY T3.name ORDER BY SUM(T2.G) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.PIM FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN TeamsSC AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.name = 'Montreal Canadiens' AND T1.year = 1918
SELECT SUM(T2.W) FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN TeamsSC AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.name = 'Montreal Canadiens' AND T2.PIM = 24
SELECT SUM(CAST(T2.W AS REAL) / T2.G) / COUNT(*) FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN TeamsSC AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.name = 'Montreal Canadiens'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.birthCountry = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.coachID) FROM Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T1.tmID = T3.tmID AND T1.year = T3.year WHERE T3.name = 'Montreal Canadiens'
SELECT COUNT(playerID) FROM Master WHERE lastName = 'Green' AND playerID IS NOT NULL AND coachID IS NULL
SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.ENG = '10' ORDER BY CAST(T1.height AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.tmID) FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.lastName = 'Young'
SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.tmID = 'BOS' AND T2.year = 1972 AND T1.coachID IS NOT NULL AND T1.hofID IS NULL

SELECT T3.firstName, T3.lastName FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year INNER JOIN Master AS T3 ON T2.playerID = T3.playerID WHERE T1.name = 'Minnesota North Stars' GROUP BY T2.playerID ORDER BY SUM(CAST(T2.GA AS INTEGER)) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.year = 2005 THEN T2.GP ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.year = 2006 THEN T2.GP ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.year = 2005 THEN T2.GP ELSE 0 END) FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.firstName = 'David' AND T1.lastName = 'Aebischer'
SELECT playerID FROM Master GROUP BY playerID HAVING AVG(height) = 75
SELECT playerID FROM Master WHERE playerID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(weight AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT playerID FROM Master WHERE deathYear IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT T1.coachID FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsCoaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.playerID IS NULL AND T1.coachID IS NOT NULL
SELECT SUM(T1.Pts), T2.coachID FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN Coaches AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.tmID = 'ANA' GROUP BY T2.coachID

SELECT DISTINCT T1.playerID, T2.tmID FROM (SELECT playerID FROM Master WHERE height IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(height AS INTEGER) ASC LIMIT 1) AS T1 INNER JOIN Scoring AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year BETWEEN 1925 AND 1936
SELECT (SELECT CAST(W AS REAL) / G FROM Teams WHERE tmID = 'CAR' AND year = 1998), (SELECT playerID FROM Scoring WHERE tmID = 'CAR' AND year = 1998 ORDER BY G DESC LIMIT 1)
